stem: Consider a square matrix A of order 3x3. If A is expanded from the first row, which of the following expressions correctly represents the determinant |A|?
solution_latex: The determinant of a 3x3 matrix A, when expanded from the first row, is given by the sum of the products of each element in the first row with its corresponding cofactor. The cofactor $A_{ij}$ is defined as $A_{ij} = (-1)^{i+j}M_{ij}$, where $M_{ij}$ is the minor of the element $a_{ij}$. Therefore, expanding from the first row ($i=1$), we get: $|A| = a_{11}A_{11} + a_{12}A_{12} + a_{13}A_{13}$. Substituting the cofactor definition: $|A| = a_{11}(-1)^{1+1}M_{11} + a_{12}(-1)^{1+2}M_{12} + a_{13}(-1)^{1+3}M_{13} = a_{11}M_{11} - a_{12}M_{12} + a_{13}M_{13}$.
